capabilities: Fetch open issues and pull requests from a configured repository
Trigger a searchable autocomplete list with a configurable character
Insert markdown links to selected issues or PRs
Access private repositories with a GitHub Personal Access Token
Manage multiple named tokens with validity indicators
disambiguation: Not a full GitHub integration; it only autocompletes issue and pull request links while typing.
extras: The README notes tokens are stored via Obsidian's SecretStorage API with hardware encryption on desktop (Keychain/DPAPI) and local storage on mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search and link GitHub issues or pull references from within the editor while typing.
summary: Editor autocomplete plugin that suggests open GitHub issues and pull requests and inserts links to them from a trigger character.
